svg.text: Bilingual boundary discrepancy · EN and TC · Temporal_ID: s205_1
Current text — English
(1) A financial receivable constitutes a recognized financial receivable taken as collateral for a
corporate, sovereign or bank exposure of an authorized institution only if it is a claim on the
obligor in respect of the receivable (referred to in this section as receivable obligor) with an
original maturity of
not more than one year
Current text — Traditional Chinese
(1)只在以下條件獲符合的情況下，財務應收項目構成視作認可機構的法團、
官方實體或銀行風險承擔的抵押品的認可財務應收項目：
該應收項目所涉及的承擔義務人(在本條中稱為應收項目承擔義務人)構成申索權，
而該應收項目的原訂到期期限
不足一年
Suggested correction
For the Law Drafting Division / policy authority to determine whether the TC wording 「不足一年」
should be aligned with the EN “not more than one year” (e.g. 「不超過一年」). No correction is
proposed unilaterally in this submission.
Source: DATA.GOV.HK dataset hk-doj-hkel-legislation-current (last modified 24 Nov 2026),
downloaded 25 Nov 2026. Rendered verbatim from the official XML (Temporal_ID s205_1). HKeL
is updated continuously; the live text may since have changed. Live HKeL text matches this
excerpt (checked 26 Nov 2026; Cap. 155L Point in Time 01/01/2026).
